risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/application (automatic vs manual, or wrong Toyota model/engine family) leading to incompatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID plate/label (part number) and a photo showing the exact gearbox type (e.g., AT vs MT) with readable markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case: incompatible/unknown application (treated as not usable for the buyer’s car).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working (internal wear, slipping, delayed engagement, or sensor/solenoid faults).
risks.proof: Short video of the gearbox being tested (engagement through gears) or a diagnostic scan showing no transmission fault codes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/needs overhaul until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Fluid condition unknown (burnt fluid, metal debris, low level) even if it “works” briefly.
risks.proof: Photo of transmission fluid level/condition (dipstick/inspection point) and a close-up of the drain/fill area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: burnt/unknown fluid condition.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete kit (torque converter, sensors, harness connectors, cooler lines, mounting brackets).
risks.proof: Inventory photos laid out: torque converter (if AT), all sensors, harness connectors, mounting brackets, and any included cooler/lines—everything included shown clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (assume missing items may require extra cost).

risks.risk: Damage from shipping/handling (cracked housing, bent shafts, broken mounts) not obvious in these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges/corners, mounting points, and any casting cracks; plus a straight-on shot of the bellhousing/face.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the transmission ID plate/label with readable part number (and AT/MT identification).
Video proof of testing: engagement through gears (or diagnostic scan showing no transmission fault codes).
Photos of included components (torque converter if automatic, sensors, harness connectors, cooler lines, mounting brackets) laid out and counted.
Photo of transmission fluid condition/level (dipstick/inspection point) and any evidence of recent service.
response.reason: The photos show gearbox assemblies, but the exact Toyota application/type and working condition cannot be verified remotely from the provided images. To price safely, we need readable ID/part number and proof of testing.
